title: Pygmy
html_source: Pygmy is an antiquated term that comes from the Ancient Greek πυγμαῖος (pugmaios), meaning “member of a race of dwarves”, commonly used as a derogatory slang term for a short person or a dwarf in the 19th and 20th centuries.
